name: The Umbrella Parade of Floating Islands
description: Dozens of colorful umbrellas carry tiny floating islands through cotton candy skies, each island hosting miniature gardens and cottages that bob gently on the breeze.
prompt: Hundreds of brightly colored umbrellas floating through a sky filled with pink and purple clouds like cotton candy, each umbrella carrying a small floating island with miniature cottages, tiny gardens, and palm trees, gentle movement suggested by flowing fabric, soft dreamy lighting, whimsical fantasy landscape, highly detailed, cheerful and magical atmosphere
caption: Following the rainbow path wherever it leads... ☂️🌈 What treasure waits on your floating isle?
